messages:
Evelyn Park: Quick thread to lock SEO tasks for the launch posts + webinar. Need: final KW list, JSON-LD for event, internal-link map, and a short redirect plan. Who can take which?
Mark Rivers: Ill map keywords to canonical URLs and suggest H1/H2 templates. Top two to hit: "llm inference platform" and "inference cost optimization". Will post mapping later today.
Aisha Qureshi: I'll own JSON-LD and structured-data QA. Proposing Event + SoftwareApplication for the demo pages. Will validate via Search Console and Lighthouse.
Mark Rivers: For internal linking, link all launch blogs to /product/inference and the main webinar landing with keyword-rich anchor text. Keep link depth to 2 clicks max.
Evelyn Park: Redirects: keep it simple, preserve utm params, and 301 canonical moves. Sample rules:
```
/promo-old -> /launch/q2-2026 301
/webinar-signup-old -> /events/webinar-q2-2026?utm_campaign=launch 301
```
DevOps Bot: Deploy reminder: edge redirect rules need the CSV by 18:00 PT for tomorrow's midnight rollout.
Aisha Qureshi: Also add QA checklist: verify canonical tags, run 301 tester, confirm noindex on staging, check JSON-LD rendering in view-source.
Evelyn Park: Thanks team  please drop files to Marketing/SEO/launch-q2 and ping eng-ops when ready.
